\(\sum E_{kf}=\frac{1}{2}(1,2)(4)^2+\frac{1}{2}(0,5)(9,6)^2=32,64\,\text{J}\).
Omdat \(38,4\,\text{J}\ne32,64\,\text{J}\), is kinetiese energie nie behoue nie. Dus is die botsing **onelasties**.

meta.final_answer: Onelasties, want kinetiese energie is nie behoue nie.
